title: Meaning of abstraction in Java
answer: Abstraction means exposing the essential operations a caller needs while hiding implementation details that the caller should not depend on. In Java, interfaces and abstract classes are common tools for this. Client code works against a stable contract, while concrete classes decide the algorithm, state, resources, or platform-specific behavior behind that contract.
